content: अनुरोधः, -धनम् .²1 Compliance, gratification, fulfilling oneʼs wishes <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Conformity, accordance, obedience, regard, consideration; धर्मानुरोधात् <ls>K. 160</ls>, <ls n="K.">180</ls>, <ls n="K.">192</ls>; अत्र नानुरोधं तर्कये <ls>Mv. 7</ls> pleasure or gratification; आधारानुरोधात् <ls>Mu. 1. 2</ls> out of regard for; कविश्रमानुरोधाद्वा <ls>Ve. 1</ls> in consideration of; दत्तोत्सेकः प्रलपति मया याज्ञवल्क्यानुरोधात् <ls>Mv. 3. 28</ls>, <ls n="Mv. 3.">5</ls>. तदनुरोधात्-धेन accordingly, in accordance with it; वदेद्विपश्चिन्महतोनुरोधात् <ls>Pt. 1. 100</ls> after great consideration; humouring; प्राप्तार्थग्रहणं द्रव्यपरीवर्तोनुरोधनम् <ls>H. 2. 101</ls>; reference (of a rule.) .²3 Pressing, urging, coaxing; entreaty, solicitation, request; क इवात्रानुरोधः <ls>K. 209</ls>; तदनुरोधात् <ls n="K.">135</ls>; विनानुरोधात्स्वहितेच्छयैव <ls>Ś. 20. 81</ls>. .²4 Bearing of a rule.
